quests.name: Fish in a Bucket
quests.progress:
I'll reward anyone who makes my life a bit easier... I enjoy doing as little as possible, mon!

Below the docks here in Shadowprey Village, I've many shellfish traps. If you're kind enough to do my work and collect me my shellfish, then I'll reward you with something you want... get my drift mon? For every five shellfish you bring me I will give you a fine Bloodbelly fish!
quests.completion: Sweet mon, nothing beats work being done, especially if it's someone else doing the work... eh?

quests.name: Centaur Bounty
quests.objective: Bring 15 Centaur Ears to Felgur Twocuts in Desolace.
quests.description:
Now that you scared the centaur clans, it's time to bleed them. When traveling Desolace, hunt centaur. I don't care which clan you hunt. Just gather ears. A hoard of ears.

By weakening their numbers you will weaken their resolve, and stamp out any thoughts of expansion.

Good hunting, <name>.
quests.progress: How is your collection of ears, <name>? Large?
quests.completion:
By now, the centaur must know your name. I'm sure they know it, and respect it, and fear it. And just as they know you, they know the banner under which you ride.

The banner of the Horde.

quests.name: Centaur Bounty
quests.objective: Bring 15 Centaur Ears to Corporal Melkins at Nijel's Point in Desolace.
quests.description:
Many clans make up the centaur race. Each has its own leader and agenda, but all the clans have one thing in common. Cruelty.

If we are to ever find peace, then the centaurs must be removed. And so I put you on the task to do just that.

While wandering Desolace, hunt centaur and take their ears. Bring me many, many ears.

Do this in service of the Alliance, <name>, and we will be one step closer to war's end.
quests.progress: Do you have a report, <name>?
quests.completion:
Ah, the ears. Well done.

Your service to the Alliance is unquestioned, <name>. The blood you spilled in Desolace will, no doubt, save countless lives.

quests.name: Hunting in Stranglethorn
quests.objective: Bring Roon's Kodo Horn to Hemet Nesingwary in Stranglethorn.
quests.description:
Long ago, a dwarf came to this land. His name was Hemet and he wished to hunt great beasts. His skills with the rifle were uncanny, and we spent many days hunting together. Even the enmity between our peoples was forgotten.

When he left Desolace for Stranglethorn, I vowed to one day welcome him back so that we may hunt again. Now is that time.

Take this kodo horn to Hemet. He will know it is from me. You will find him in Stranglethorn, north of the Grom'gol Base camp.
quests.progress: Sit, <class>. Soon enough you'll strike back into the jungle.
quests.completion:
Ah, this horn belongs to a Tauren, Roon Wildmane. He and I had a good time hunting the beasts of Desolace. So Roon is inviting me back, is he?

We're neck deep in the jungle right now, but thank you, <name>. Perhaps my next expedition will take me back to Desolace, the land of the centaurs.

quests.name: Regthar Deathgate
quests.objective: Speak with Regthar Deathgate.
quests.description:
A warrior of the Horde, Regthar Deathgate, is recruiting agents for a mission into the land of Desolace. Speak with him if you wish to volunteer. He is stationed in the Barrens, in a series of bunkers west of the Crossroads.

And sharpen your weapons. Desolace is a place torn by war.
quests.completion: Yes, I am recruiting. This mission leads into Desolace, against the centaur there. I will be brief so that you may quickly begin.

quests.name: The Kolkar of Desolace
quests.objective: Speak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace.
quests.description:
The Kolkar centaur live in Desolace, and their forces have spread into the Barrens. This is a known fact and we have Horde agents dealing with them here.

But as long as the centaur are strong in Desolace, they will always pose a threat. It is time we rid ourselves of that threat.

Speak with Felgur Twocuts at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace. He was sent to gather intelligence on the centaur. He will know how to best deal with the Kolkar of Desolace.
quests.completion:
You are here on orders from Regthar? Then you are here to deal with the centaur. Good.

I hope you're rested. I don't know how our campaign against the centaur will end, but I know the struggle will be long.

Have a seat, and listen.

quests.name: Raid on the Kolkar
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring 10 Crude Charms to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
quests.description:
The Kolkar centaurs think their magic is strong. They do not know magic! They would not know magic if it bit them!

You will show them their magic is weak. Go to the Kolkar to the northeast and kill them. Take their charms. Bring me the charms and I will throw them in the fire and laugh!
quests.progress: You have the charms? You showed the Kolkar they are weak?
quests.completion:
You do a good thing for the Gelkis. The Kolkar are weak and will die. Their magic is pathetic and will not save them. You showed them this, and their fear will make them even more feeble!

And in our lands, the feeble soon die.

quests.name: Assault on the Kolkar
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Magram. Kill 12 Kolkar Centaurs, 12 Kolkar Scouts and 6 Kolkar Maulers, then return to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
quests.description: The Kolkar think they are strong, but we laugh at them! We laugh and we kill them! You kill them too. Show me you can kill Kolkar like we do. Head north and slay them all!
quests.progress: Are you afraid of the Kolkar? Why do you not kill them? Maybe you forgot how to kill. Hurry and kill Kolkar before they are dead!
quests.completion: The Kolkar fear you now! I hope you laughed when you killed them. It is better to laugh when you kill, so the enemy can see he is weak.

quests.name: Magram Alliance
quests.objective: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Magram, then speak with Warug.
quests.description:
To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them. We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans.

If you choose to ally with the Magram then slay their foes, the Gelkis. This will earn you respect among the Magram. When you earn enough, then meet with the Magram spokesman Warug, on the outskirts of the Magram Village, in southeast Desolace.
quests.progress:
Leave! The Magram do not speak with the weak. We kill them!

If you want to speak with me, then show me you are strong. Return after you slay many Gelkis.
quests.completion:
The Gelkis cry when they hear your name, <name>. They fear you and they hate you. They hate you like they hate the Magram!

Maybe you are strong like the Magram. We will see...

quests.name: Gelkis Alliance
quests.objective: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Gelkis, then speak with Uthek the Wise.
quests.description:
To beat the centaur, we must use their hatred against them. We will ally with one of the clans and through them, we will learn how to defeat all the clans.

If you choose to ally with the Gelkis then slay their most hated rival, the Magram. After you earn the respect of the Gelkis, meet with the Gelkis shaman Uthek the Wise, on the outskirts of the Gelkis Village, in southwest Desolace.
quests.progress:
Your two feet step on Gelkis earth. You are not welcome here!

Prove you seek friendship with the Gelkis. Kill Magram centaur. Return when the ground is wet with Magram blood.
quests.completion:
The earth speaks to me. And it says you have killed many Magram. This is good.

If you are a friend of the Gelkis, then listen. I have more tasks for you.

quests.name: Broken Tears
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Broken Tears to Warug in the Magram Village.
quests.description:
The Gelkis think our centaur mother, Theradras, protects us. They are stupid. No one protects the centaur. The Magram do not need protection! We are the strongest!

Show the Gelkis they are stupid. Go to the cave in their village. They hoard crystals in that cave, the tears of Theradras. Destroy the tears and bring me the broken pieces!
quests.progress: If you are not our enemy, then you will do what I ask!
quests.completion:
You got the tears! Now the Gelkis will know that Theradras will not help them. She will not cry when we crush them! The Magram will rule!

You are smart to help us, <name>. We are the strongest.

quests.name: Alliance Relations
quests.objective: Speak to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.
quests.description:
The Burning Blade have many agendas, but know that they are evil to their core, their spirits corrupted, and their destruction is the only way to thwart their objectives.

Keldran sent Maurin with me because of his knowledge of the Blade and their warlock ways.

He has control of our plots against the Blade while I deal with the other demonic threats here in Desolace.

Speak to him, and he will guide you in his designs.
quests.completion:
Ah, yes. Aid from those loyal to the Warchief is always appreciated.

My name is Maurin. I am here at the behest of Keldran and the Warchief cub Thrall. It is my desire to aid the youngling leader against the evils that threaten his rule.

Come, come closer, <class>. I shall explain to you my plan for removing the festering boil that is the Burning Blade.

quests.name: Befouled by Satyr
quests.objective: Slay 7 Hatefury Rogues, 7 Hatefury Felsworn, 7 Hatefury Betrayers, and 7 Hatefury Hellcallers, and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
quests.description:
A demon infestation does not occur without other influences--something else allows evil to gain a foothold.

It may start with a weakened spirit, a needless desire for power; perhaps it's a thirst for revenge, or the appeal for final justice. When we are beset by pain, evil takes advantage of us--evil such as the satyr.

Ties have been made between them and the Burning Blade, and Thrall would have them slain. Seek them out to the northeast of here, and return to me when you've driven them back.
quests.progress:
I was warned by a tauren companion that the satyr are not all they appear to be. He believes there is something more to them, that their evil is a twisting of their true nature. But I have not seen such things.

I see only the ruthless slaughter of the weak and the corruption of those who seek dark power.

I will continue in my duty of annihilating them until the Warchief directs me otherwise. Until then, I take no pity on them.
quests.completion:
You have done well, <class>. You have shown honor and dedication.

When our campaign in Desolace is done, the Warchief will know that you aided us in our actions here, and that you helped make his will manifest.

I thank you.

quests.name: The Burning of Spirits
quests.objective: Return the Burning Gem and 15 Infused Burning Gems to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.
quests.description:
Death is most desirable for those despicable creatures that turn their back on their liege for such selfish reasons. But death is not enough when dealing with those that have given themselves over to the darkness.

Take this gem. When one of the Burning Blade's near death, activate its magic. The spell shall pull the corrupted spirit out of its victim, leaving an infused gem behind.

Bring me these infused gems so I may dispose of them properly.

Go now, and may you elude death.
quests.progress: I have tried to make the magics as simple as possible. Drawing the spirit of your victim out of its injured form should be child's play. Do not rely on the gem's power to slay your foe completely. You must only activate the gem when they are close to death, or it will be useless.
quests.completion:
Ah, you've returned successful. That is good. Give me the gems and I shall put them someplace safe....

My tasks for you are complete, <class>. Speak to Takata when you are rested. He may have other tasks for you, or perhaps needs you to return to Orgrimmar to inform Keldran of our progress here in Desolace.

quests.name: Vahlarriel's Search
quests.objective: Find and search Tyranis and Dalinda Malem's wagon in Desolace.
quests.description:
I am Vahlarriel, <name>. I've come here to discover the whereabouts of two missing nobles of a Darnassian merchant family--House Malem. The father of the house fears the worst, and I am to do everything I can to find his missing children. I have yet to start my search for Tyranis or Dalinda, but I am hopeful I shall not be here long.

Last word tells of them passing through the Stonetalon Mountains a few weeks ago.

If you find their wagon, please, come find me immediately.
quests.completion:
As you rummage around the remains of the wagon, it becomes obvious that it was attacked by both spells and weapons. The battle seemed one-sided and quick; there's no blood to be found, and no remains of any bodies.

Whoever attacked the wagon was efficient and swift.

quests.name: Vahlarriel's Search
quests.objective: Find Dalinda Malem in Desolace.
quests.description:
Find both Dalinda and Tyranis if you can and come back to me with your findings. Start your search at this fortress. I will contact my superiors in Darnassus immediately and let them know the situation.

<name>, there is something else I wish to impress upon you. My superiors have shown some concern over Tyranis' and his motives for coming here. It is more important to them that Dalinda is found and brought back safely. Tyranis is to be... gauged before he is taken home.
quests.completion:
Thank Elune someone has finally come to help. Please, <class>, I need your help. My brother Tyranis and I were captured and brought here by the Burning Blade. I think they mean to sacrifice me to their demon masters!

I knew coming to Desolace was a mistake, but Tyranis has recently begun craving knowledge of all things arcane--even against the wishes of our people. He decided to make this trek even after hearing tales of this land's demon infestation.

I fear the worst for him.

quests.name: Search for Tyranis
quests.objective: Find Tyranis Malem in Desolace.
quests.description:
We were brought here after the orcs slaughtered all our guards and servants. Oh, the terrible things they did to them! I thought surely they would kill us right there and then, but it became obvious they had other plans.

Tyranis attempted to speak to them. I think he wanted to impress them with his knowledge of the arcane... I'm not sure why.

Please, I can't leave here until I know what's happened to my brother. Find him, then come back for me when his fate is known.
quests.progress:
I fear Tyranis will attempt to learn the Burning Blade's secrets and count himself among their kind if they allow it--he has always adored the power magic brings to those who are seduced by it.

I'm not sure I could endure returning home to my family with news of Tyranis' spirit flirting with such dangers. It's a terrible enough crime among my kind to pursue such things, but to become that which we attempt to protect ourselves from, well, that's apprehensible.
quests.completion:
This is terrible! But I suppose it was necessary. If it wasn't by your hand, it would have surely been by that of my people's. I suppose I should thank you--please forgive me if it doesn't seem sincere. I mean no offense.

With the knowledge of my brother's fate in hand, it seems the time for my escape has come. If you are still willing, I will accept your aid in escaping this horrible place.

When you are ready, we can make our way to safety.

quests.name: Return to Vahlarriel
quests.objective: Escort Dalinda Malem from Thunder Axe Fortress and then return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer in Desolace.
quests.description: So, the time is now then? I appreciate your efforts, and if the situation does not lend itself, then allow me to thank you now for everything you've done for me and my family. If you're ready, then there is nothing else for me here--we can leave when you feel the time is right.
quests.completion:
Thank you, <name>. Dalinda made it safely back here to Nijel's Point, and in much better condition than I could have asked for. The fact that she arrived here under her own power was a good sign. I hope you're well?

It pains me to know that both Tyranis and Dalinda didn't return, but the embarrassment of Tyranis' decisions is hers to endure. It is something she will have to deal with when she returns to Darnassus.

quests.name: Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.
quests.objective: Bring 10 Hatefury Claws, and 10 Hatefury Horns to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
quests.description:
One of my tasks out here involves picking up some reagents for Leftwitch, a gnome mage in Kharanos . Roetten seems to think it's easy coin in the bank since we're out here already. He doesn't really care that we're short-handed as is.

The first few items on his list should be easy enough to get, and it'd be a good chunk of coin for anyone helping me out.

I need some horns and claws from the Hatefury satyr to the east of here. Bring 'em back to me and we'll get started on the rest of the list.
quests.progress:
Despicable creatures, the satyr. Story says they're somehow tied to the night elves, but I'm not so sure I believe it.

I think they get that on account of that one elf that brought them into the war few years back. World's never been the same since. Lot more dangerous, and a lot scarier.
quests.completion:
Good good, <name>. Not sure if these are of any good quality, but if Leftwitch wanted a specific type, he should have specified before sending the Reclaimers out here to begin with.

What say you to getting on with the next item on his list?

quests.name: Vahlarriel's Search
quests.objective: Return the Malem Pendant to Vahlarriel Demonslayer in Desolace.
quests.description:
As you continue your search of the wagon you find not only a pendant, but also footprints leading off towards the south. In the distance you can see smoke rising from a large fort. The smoke is from a kept fire, not the burning of buildings, and your instincts tell you that the Malems, if still alive, were taken that direction.

You think Vahlarriel at Nijel's Point should not only see the pendant you've found, but also know about the signs of life to the south.
quests.completion:
Infuriating! This entire fiasco!

The two of them were warned about how dangerous coming here would be. Now they're both missing... or worse.

You said you saw tracks heading to a fort nearby? That may be our best bet.

From what the locals have said, that fortress is infested with members of the Burning Blade--orcs who have dedicated themselves to demon causes. They may not represent the majority of the Horde's beliefs, but they are evil and will slay you on sight if you're caught spying.

quests.name: The Corrupter
quests.objective: Bring the Flayed Demon Skin to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.
quests.description:
The torn skin smells rotten, and is remarkably pliable for something that appears to be dry and fragile.

As you unroll it, you can clearly see the red markings of some kind of language on one side. At the bottom of the skin is a very clear symbol that you guess is a signature of some kind.

Perhaps it is something Maurin could tell you more about?
quests.progress:
The Burning Blade begin to realize how weak they truly are. Their magics are pathetic, their strength feeble.

Their only power comes from those they serve, and not from any understanding of true power and knowledge.
quests.completion: Hmm, these runes are indeed a language, <name>, an old language. They seem remotely similar to the Eredun language, but the differences are drastic. If I am not mistaken, this is a contract of some kind.... Here, yes, this symbol is the demon's signature: Lord Azrethoc.

quests.name: The Corrupter
quests.objective: Bring a Shadowstalker Scalp to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.
quests.description:
I believe I can find this demon lord given the proper reagents.

If he is indeed as powerful as I suspect, I will need items gathered from deadly creatures. But you act in the Warchief's name, so I am sure you will accept my task.

First, I will have to break any wards he has against scrying. For this, I will need the scalp from a satyr--but not any satyr. The scalp must come from a Hatefury shadowstalker.

Search for them among the ancient ruins in the northeast of Desolace.
quests.progress:
Do not bring me an incorrect scalp, <class>. Using the incorrect reagents could cause our deaths. The demon lord may have contingency spells on his person to slay those who would scry upon him.

Fate has already dealt me enough pain.
quests.completion:
The shadowstalkers were unable to slay you, <class>. Impressive... most impressive.

This scalp will do nicely for my spell. While you were away, I was able to gather some of the other reagents needed for the spell.

I am almost ready. I only need a focus for the spell--something to project an image of the demon lord and his whereabouts.

quests.name: The Corrupter
quests.objective: Speak to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
quests.description:
This creature is far more dangerous than I had anticipated. No doubt Takata questions my abilities to take on such a creature, and it would insult his honor if he were not informed about what just happened.

Speak to the swordsman, tell him you are willing to slay the demon if he would allow it, but do not press too hard. It is better if he thinks it his own idea.
quests.completion: I witnessed what just occurred with Maurin and the demon lord. That creature, even as an apparition, seems to have more power than my warlock companion. I wonder if he's up to the task of defeating the monster? It would serve the Warchief better if I go myself, but with my responsibilities here, I would disgrace my clan if I turned my back on my duties here to battle this evil for my own honor.

quests.name: Sceptre of Light
quests.objective: Get the Sceptre of Light and then return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.
quests.description:
The Burning Blade in Thunder Axe Fortress to the east is rumored to have acquired the Sceptre of Light from the Naga. Legend tells that the sceptre is able to sink entire cities under the great seas. The Burning Blade must not be allowed to possess such power.

To that end, you must retrieve the sceptre yourself! It is held by a Burning Blade seer, who studies the sceptre from atop one of the Thunder Axe watchtowers.
quests.progress: Do you have the Sceptre of Light?
quests.completion: The elusive Sceptre of Light! Your acquisition of it has removed a grave threat to the world. Well done, <class>, well done.

quests.name: Hate the Hatefury
quests.objective: Defeat a variety of Hatefury satyr at Sargeron in Desolace and then return to Aka'rai in Shadowprey Village.
quests.description:
Ever strike a deal with a satyr, mon?

I have. How could I resist? The promise of power, knowledge far exceeding what any ordinary tome could offer... all alongside an eager and charismatic minion. What more could I ask for?

Bah, of course they would never bend the knee to a mortal. I bargained when I had nothing, only to be cast aside with even less.

Now, I want revenge. Revenge against the Hatefury. Raid their camp to the northeast! Stain the dirt with their foul blood.
quests.completion:
I wish I had been able to watch your battles unfold and hear their wretched screams as they fell to your might.

But one of them surely eluded your slaughter. The one whose hand I shook in a ritual of spilled blood. So long as he roams the Desolace, I cannot risk stepping foot outside of Shadowprey. He would soon find me again, and with my soulstone in his possession... not even death would be an escape.

Eventually, I will have it back. But for now, your work is done.

quests.name: Vahlarriel's Vengeance
quests.objective: Slay Burning Blade orcs at Thunder Axe Fortress in the Desolace, then return to Vahlarriel Demonslayer at Nijel's Point.
quests.description:
If Malem is still alive, then I suspect the Burning Blade orcs are expecting someone to come searching for her soon enough. They will certainly be ready for a fight.

I would prefer if you kept a low profile and stayed out of their way, but the far more likely reality is that they will be looking to meet you, blade to Burning Blade, at every opportunity.

So how about we plan to keep score from the start. Kill as many as you can, and I'll make it worth your time.
quests.completion:
Good work. With all your efforts against those fools at Thunder Axe, surely they will think twice before ransacking another caravan passing through.

With any luck, they'll cower behind their gates for long enough to die out on their own.

quests.name: Kodo Roundup
quests.objective: Bring five Tamed Kodos and the Kodo Kombobulator back to Smeed Scrabblescrew at Scrabblescrew's Camp.
quests.description:
Bibbly thinks he is the only goblin in Desolace who knows how to make money. Well, the only caravan brave enough to travel these parts relies on me. Ever since I learned how to rejuvenate and control aged and dying kodos with my kodo kombobulator, the caravan owner Cork, Rigger, and I entered a partnership.

Take the kombobulator and use it on any ancient, aged, or dying kodos; it will jolt the beast into a tamed kodo and force it to follow you. Once you have a kodo tamed, bring it back to me.
quests.progress: The caravan will be here shortly; do you have the five new tamed kodos I was asking for?
quests.completion:
<Smeed Scrabblescrew begins counting.>

Three, four, and five... excellent, I ask for five tamed kodos and I get five tamed kodos... I am going to be rich... yes, very rich! I hope to see the look on Bibbly's green face when he hears about my success!

quests.name: Khan Dez'hepah
quests.objective: Bring Khan Dez'hepah's Head to Felgur Twocuts in Desolace.
quests.description:
The Kolkar are not the only centaur of Desolace. Many clans wander these dry plains, fighting and dying against each other. And it is good that they fight among themselves, for they are strong and brutal. If the centaur united against us, they would be a fierce foe.

We must deal with them before they unite.

Your first task is to disrupt the Kolkar clan. Do this by killing its leader, Khan Dez'hepah.

The Kolkar Village is northeast of here. Go, and may fortune go with you.
quests.progress: <name>, have you defeated Khan Dez'hepah?
quests.completion:
Well done. This swift act against the Kolkar is an effective show of strength, and strength is what the centaur understand best.

The death of the Kolkar leader will not only disrupt that clan, but give pause to the others.

quests.name: Stealing Supplies
quests.objective: Bring 6 bags of Crudely Dried Meat to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village.
quests.description:
When we are not at war, we hunt for meat. Meat gives us strength, and full bellies fight harder than empty ones.

It is the same with the Magram. They store extra meat so they may fight longer between hunts. If you raid their village to the east and take their stores of meat, then their strength will fail.
quests.progress: Return after you further prove your worth to the Gelkis!
quests.completion:
Good. I can hear the loud Magram bellies grumble from their village, far away!

I will give this meat to the Gelkis. And we will fight for many days without rest.

What you did is good for the Gelkis, <name>.

quests.name: Gizmo for Warug
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring an Advanced Target Dummy to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
quests.description:
Long ago, a little gnome came to Desolace. He had horses and a cart, and the cart held strange things. Funny things. Things that burned different colors. Things that moved and weren't alive. I killed the little gnome, but before that... he made me laugh.

I kept my favorite thing from his cart. It was a human made of wood and it waved at me until I hit it and broke it.

I want a new one. Get me a new one!
quests.progress: If you are not our enemy, then you will do what I ask!
quests.completion: Yes, this is what I had! I will make it move again. It makes me laugh!

quests.name: Strange Alliance
quests.objective: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Gelkis, then speak with Uthek the Wise.
quests.description:
We are fortunate the centaur clans fight among themselves, for if they joined into a single force then they would be unstoppable. Yes, we are fortunate, and we should press our advantage.

One of the centaur clans, the Gelkis clan, is in brutal war with the Magram clan. If we attack the Magram, then perhaps an alliance may be struck with the Gelkis.

Speak with Uthek the Wise, in the outskirts of the Gelkis camps in southwestern Desolace. Through her we might strike an alliance with the Gelkis.
quests.progress:
Be gone! The Gelkis do not want you here. Leave now!!

Return after killing many Magram, and then I will speak with you.
quests.completion:
Your name is whispered among the Gelkis. You have much Magram blood on your hands. This is good.

Maybe it is also good if we speak. Speak of what you can do for the Gelkis, and what we can do for you.

quests.name: Brutal Politics
quests.objective: Gain a Friendly reputation with the Magram, then speak with Warug.
quests.description:
Desolace is a land at war. The centaurs wage war with each other, and we believe the victor among them will spill out and threaten our strongholds. That, we cannot allow

We must learn how to beat the centaurs, and to do that... we must ally with one of the clans. The Magram centaurs war with the Gelkis. If you fight the Gelkis then the Magram might consider an alliance.

Earn the favor of the Magrams then speak with Warug, in the Magram village in southeastern Desolace.
quests.progress: You will go now, or the Magram will crush you! To be our friend, you must kill Gelkis.
quests.completion: Many Gelkis fall to you. I like that. Maybe you can do more things I like. Maybe you and the Magram can be friends.

quests.name: Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.
quests.objective: Bring 7 vials of Scorpashi Venom and 3 Aged Kodo Hides to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
quests.description:
Next on Leftwitch's list is... let's see... hmm. Oh, here it is.

Simple enough, but pretty explicit in his directions. He needs venom from the scorpashi, and hide from some kodo. The fine print says both are from specific creatures: the venom's got to come from any of the scorpashi, and the hide's got to come from an aged kodo, not the dying or ancient ones.

Mages, I tell ya, some of the stuff they want... it's just weird.
quests.progress: Sorry I couldn't tell you where to find the kodo or the scorpashi. I'm not terribly familiar with the area, and I haven't had time to explore.
quests.completion:
Your help here's a boon, <name>. You're cutting my time spent here in Desolace by half at least. I'll be back in Ironforge warming my feet in no time with your help.

When we get this list taken care of, and I'm back home, look me up, I'll buy you an ale for sure.

But until then, let's get the rest of these reagents gathered.

quests.name: The Corrupter
quests.objective: Bring an Oracle Crystal to Maurin Bonesplitter in Desolace.
quests.description:
An oracle crystal would do nicely. They are crafted by the naga for their oracles to use.

Northwest of here, along the coast, is a vast coral reef that the naga have taken as their home when this close to the shore. You can find their oracles there. The Slitherblade are deadly and will not react kindly to your intrusions, so be careful and make haste.

When you return, we shall see about finding this demon lord Azrethoc.
quests.progress: I am ready for the oracle crystal, <class>. Finding and destroying this Lord Azrethoc would garner a great deal of favor with the Warchief for both of us. We would do well to work together and to do so swiftly so we may further our own ends and curry favor with the Warchief.
quests.completion:
A precious oracle crystal... flawless... beautiful. Indeed.

We shall begin immediately. Finding this demon lord should be our primary concern, and its slaying demands our utmost attention.

Take a step back, <class>, and let us see what this demon is, and where he may be found.

quests.name: Bodyguard for Hire
quests.objective: Escort the Gizelton Caravan past the Kolkar Centaur village. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.

objectives.text: Escort Gizelton Caravan past Kolkar Centaur Village

quests.description:
Under normal circumstances, Rigger and I would lead our kodo past the Kolkar Centaur. Every now and then we hear the Centaur war drums, and when we hear those we stop. It's not good for business to be dead!

I'll tell you what <class>, if you protect us past the Kolkar village we'll make it worth your while.

It's just a short distance, all you need to do is keep the caravan intact and you can pick up your reward from Smeed Scrabblescrew - he is down the road a bit. We do a little business together.
quests.completion: You know, it doesn't seem prosperous to be paying the likes of you to guard Gizelton Caravan. <class>, if I were a bit taller I could take on a second job and sit kodo-side-saddle with the biggest gun my hands could carry... and I'd show them blasted centaur who's their papa.

quests.name: Clam Bait
quests.objective: Find 10 pieces of Soft-shelled Clam Meat and bring it back to Mai'Lahii at Shadowprey Village.
quests.description:
You have the look of a fisherman, <class>! I love to fish - been fishing all my life. The best bait to use is soft-shelled clam meat; the fish just can't resist, you know what I mean?

Up north you will find a wrecked ship off the coast. Soft-shelled clams are littered throughout the area. If you bring me back 10 pieces of soft-shelled clam meat, I will give you something in return.
quests.progress: I can't wait to go fishing with some fresh soft-shelled clam meat; did you bring me the 10 pieces of it I need?
quests.completion:
Perfect mon, this is just what the witch doctor told me to do for my headache. He says, "Mai'Lahii - go fish. It'll make you feel better"

Well, I feel better already, thanks mon!

quests.name: A New Need for Shadow Protection
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 3 Greater Shadow Protection Potions to Mirda in the Magram Village in Desolace.
quests.description:
Our clanmates continue to venture further south, to and beyond the cursed Valley of Bones.

Despite your standing with our clan, I do not trust you enough to share the details of their ventures. They would be boring to you anyway, outsider.

What matters to you is our need for Greater Shadow Protection Potions, in bulk, to ensure their continued survival. Bring some to me, and I will put in a good word for you.
quests.progress: My patience runs thin, outsider.
quests.completion: Ah, you came through for us. The Magram clan will never forget your contributions. When we come to rule over Desolace, you and your kind will be spared from our wrath.

quests.name: Mysterious Mysticism
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring 3 Greater Mystic Essences to Halea in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
quests.description:
With each passing day, our scavengers return with fewer and fewer armaments from fallen adventurers.

While we cannot use these pieces directly, we do salvage them for scraps. The most magical of the armaments go to me, as I can disenchant them and make use of the mysterious remnants to enchant our weapons, particularly those of our windchasers.

I am in need of Greater Mystic Essences if I am to supply our next raiding party with worthwhile equipment.
quests.progress:
Our clan draws most of our power from the Tears of Theradras, many of which you may have seen scattered about the walls of the khan's cave. But as time passes, some are lost, destroyed, or simply depleted.

These types of reagents are new to me, though the enchantments themselves are not.
quests.completion:
Your kindness is strange, nearly unheard of in these lands.

Disenchanting equipment is still a foreign concept to me, and I often feel as though I am not drawing the full potential from these old items. These essences you provided help recover some of my losses.

The Gelkis Clan, and especially our mystics, thank you.

choice.name: Formula: Enchant Bracer - Lesser Healing Power

quests.name: I Need a Tailor
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a White Bandit Mask to Molkar in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
quests.description:
My mate, Halea, is tasked with ensuring our armaments are empowered with appropriate magical energy.

The whole concept of enchanting is far beyond my understanding, but as the centaur whose job is to keep our village well supplied and equipped, I know that Halea is often behind on her duties--to no fault of her own.

I would like to gift her some simple clothes to practice her craft on. I see some adventurers wandering through sandstorms with simple facemasks. Could you get me a few of those?
quests.progress: Your assistance here would be like impaling two Magram on one pike! You aid the Gelkis in our war effort, and you help Halea improve her skills.
quests.completion:
These are a little tattered and I see some frayed stitching, but nonetheless great quality. Better than most of the torn, battered, bloodied equipment she gets handed to her daily.

You have my thanks.

quests.name: Leather Technique
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a Barbaric Harness to Talra in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
quests.description:
Convincing my Gelkis clanmates to put on armor is nigh impossible, despite the numerous losses we have suffered with blades or bolts through the chest.

I have been tasked with designing a vest that offers some reasonable protection, without the supposed 'itchiness' that they complain about. Supplies are scarce, so I dare not waste precious leather on junk.

Outsider, would you bring me a harness fit to a brutish centaur? I would like to learn from your technique.
quests.progress: You may have all the time in the world, outsider, but my kind is in the midst of war. If you intend to help, do hurry.
quests.completion:
Hm. I suppose I was not specific enough in my request. Maybe there is still some knowledge to be gained here by studying this.

Regardless, you continue to provide assistance to the Gelkis, so I will inform the others of your help.

quests.name: Big, No, MASSIVE Iron Axes
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring 2 Massive Iron Axes to Grolkar in the Magram Village in Desolace.
quests.description:
WE NEED MORE WEAPONS.

MORE. WEAPONS.

HOW ELSE IS THE MAGRAM GOING TO SMASH PUNY GELKIS?

I WANT TO SEE WHAT YOU CAN MAKE, OUTSIDER. BRING ME AXES. BIG, NO, MASSIVE ONES.

HURRY UP.
quests.progress: I SAID HURRY UP.
quests.completion:
THESE ARE PERFECT. BETTER THAN MINE. I HATE THAT.

MAGRAM THANK YOU NOW. YOU TEACH ME LATER.

quests.name: Other Fish to Fry
quests.objective: Slay 7 Slitherblade Myrmidon, 7 Slitherblade Naga, and 5 Slitherblade Sorceresses, and then talk to Drulzegar at Shadowprey in Desolace.
quests.description:
Maybe you heard or maybe you haven't... my crew and I was out fishing near Ranazjar Isle, north of the wrecked ship off the coast up north. We used to fish there all the time; now all I do is think of a way to seek revenge for my fallen comrades.

The naga attacked us one morning, killing everyone except me.

Me conscience can't handle the guilt, <class>; I need you to go and fry them naga for me. I'll make the effort worth your while; you think you can help me with that?
quests.completion:
As sweet as it is hearing the news that the naga have been vanquished, my heart still feels empty. For the rest of my life I will be dedicated to having them all killed.

Here mon, your reward as I promised. It's small in comparison to the gratification of knowing the naga fried for their hated act upon my crew.

quests.name: Claim Rackmore's Treasure!
quests.objective: Find Rackmore's Silver Key. Find Rackmore's Golden Key. Find and open Rackmore's Chest.
quests.description:
Rackmore's log tells of how his ship was sailing for Feathermoon Stronghold when it was attacked by seafaring creatures. To prevent his treasure from falling into enemy hands, he hid his chest on Ranazjar Isle.

To open the chest requires two keys, a silver and a gold. These keys were lost, but if the keys and the chest are found, a treasure awaits!
quests.progress: This chest is securely locked.
quests.completion: Chest opens to reveal Rackmore's treasure!

quests.name: Ongeku
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring a Draenethyst Shard to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village in Desolace.
quests.description:
You have more to prove, and your next task will take you far, so for now the Gelkis will fight the Magram without you.

The earth whispers many secrets to those who listen. One secret I hear is of a red crystal. It is called draenethyst, and it is new to our earth. It comes from a place where mountains fly, and where demons rule.

Bring me a shard of draenethyst, and it will make my magic strong! The shard is in a place called the Swamp of Sorrows, held by the lost one Ongeku.
quests.progress: Show me you are a friend of the Gelkis, <name>.
quests.completion:
Yes, this is the shard of which the earth whispered. I can feel strong magic in it! I will use this magic against the enemies of the Gelkis.

You have done one more task for us, <name>. Maybe soon, we will call you friend.

quests.name: Khan Shaka
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and bring the Head of Khan Shaka to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
quests.description: You help the Magram, and I like you. Now, kill the Khan of the Gelkis! He is Khan Shaka, and I want his head! I want to stare at his head and laugh at him!
quests.progress: Do tasks for the Magram, and I will help you.
quests.completion: Khan Shaka is dead! I will place his head on a pike, and keep it with me so Shaka can see the strength of the Magram!

quests.name: Catch of the Day
quests.objective: Talk to Jinar'Zillen at Shadowprey Village, and then bring Nataka Longhorn 2 Bloodbelly fish.
quests.description:
The smell of cooked fish has long been missing here at Ghost Walker Post. The trolls at Shadowprey Village are the best at catching fish... but alas, with all the centaur activities I have little time to make a journey to the trolls. Hrm...

Do me a favor and journey to Shadowprey Village. Talk to the local fisherman Jinar'Zillen and bring me back my favorite, Bloodbelly fish. The road south of here will take you west to the troll village.
quests.progress: My hoof tingles and my mouth starts to water when I think of fried Bloodbelly fish... You have any on you?
quests.completion:
You are a savior, <name>! These Bloodbelly fish look almost good enough to eat raw.

Here you go - choose one of these items as a payment for these fish.

quests.name: Hand of Iruxos
quests.objective: Retrieve the Demon Box from Thunder Axe Fortress, and return it, along with the Demon Pick to Taiga Wisemane in Shadowprey Village.
quests.description:
The Burning Blade possesses the Demon Box. Within it lies the powerful Hand of Iruxos. The Burning Blade uses it to open demonic portals at Mannoroc Coven. We must stop the tide of demons entering our world, <name>!

Use this demon pick on the red crystal in Thunder Axe Fortress to gain access to the Demon Box.
quests.progress: <name>, do you have the Demon Box?
quests.completion: Ah, the Demon Box. Give it to me, <class>, and I shall open... and thus reveal to you the Hand of Iruxos.

quests.name: Portals of the Legion
quests.objective: Banish 6 Portals at Mannoroc Coven and return to Taiga Wisemane at Shadowprey Village.
quests.description:
Behold - the Hand of Iruxos. A gruesome sight indeed.

You must possess it if the demon portals at Mannoroc Coven are to be banished... which is what I now ask you to do. The Demon threat is increasing and we must close these portals to stem the tide of demons to this world. Good luck, <name>... and be wary of the portal guardians.
quests.progress: Have you banished the demon portals at Mannoroc Coven?
quests.completion: You are to be commended, <name>. Your effort has helped greatly in fighting the demon threat, and all of Azeroth is safer because of it.

quests.name: Gizelton Caravan
quests.objective: Escort the Gizelton Caravan through Mannoroc Coven. Talk with Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp for your reward.

objectives.text: Escort Gizelton Caravan past Mannoroc Coven

quests.description:
You look like a capable <race>. Perhaps you're looking to make some money? Cork and I started this caravan to make a bundle of money; little did we know the dangers of turning a buck!

Up ahead is Mannoroc Coven... normally the demons ignore us but something has the kodos spooked this time. I'll pay you to protect the caravan past Mannoroc Coven. Once we are safely past you can receive your reward from our business associate Smeed at Scrabblescrew's Camp.
quests.completion: Not sure it's a prosperous proposition to be paying so much money to protect the Gizelton Caravan. Cork and Rigger only make one gold piece a week, but as long as they keep paying for my kodos I can care less how they run their business.

quests.name: Book of the Ancients
quests.objective: Get the Book of the Ancients and return it to Azore Aldamort at the tower in Ethel Rethor.
quests.description: <name>, I entrust you with the Gem of the Serpent. Place this gem on the Serpent Statue's hand on Ranazjar Isle, a small island northwest of here. Placing it will summon the one who protects the Book of the Ancients. This book contains the secrets of the naga, secrets that have been kept for centuries. Bring this book to me, and we will learn much about our scaled foes!
quests.progress: Ah, <name>! It's good to see you again. Do you have the Book of the Ancients?
quests.completion: The long lost Book of the Ancients! I will ensure this book is passed on to the high council. You've done well today, and for that you are to be thanked... as a hero should be thanked!

quests.name: A Cleansing Cry
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring Tears of Theradras back to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village.
quests.description:
When you return to Nerlokh in the Valley of Bones, it will not be empty-handed.

Go inside the cave at the heart of our village and seek out Mulara. Ask for Tears of Theradras on my behalf. Our supply is low, but it is our best hope against the Magram's foul necromancy!

I will prepare a ritual. We will create a weapon to disrupt their spells.
quests.progress: Hurry, <name>. Nerlokh should not be left unguarded for long.
quests.completion:
I am grateful that Mulara was able to come to our aid. I knew she would try to help, but worried that she would have no crystals to spare.

Take a moment to clear your mind. I will soon explain my plan.

quests.name: Test Your Theory
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and dispel the necromantic curse present on the Accursed Skull. Once successful, report back to Nerlokh near the Valley of Bones.
quests.description:
I have placed the skull you provided alongside several bones I found while awaiting your return. Immediately I saw a sickly light spread from the skull and claim those old bones as its own. I see now why the call of necromancy is so hard to resist.

Do you remember this crystal? It is draenethyst. I know little of its potential, but I believe it can channel Theradras' power. With it, perhaps you can dispel the curse.

The ritual site can be found by the pond just east of the village.
quests.progress: <name>! You return from Gelkis Village? I trust Uthek was able to offer some insight.
quests.completion:
That staff looks like one of Uthek's, but I do not recognize its gemstone. You say it is called draenethyst?

<Nerlokh listens to you recall recent events and watches your profoundly expressive <race> gestures.>

A weapon to counter necromancy is precisely what we need, and if Uthek is entrusting you with one of her greatstaves then she must have great confidence in this plan.

I have news of my own to share.

quests.name: Lost Shipping Crate
quests.objective: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
quests.description:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
quests.completion:
Where did you say you found this? I'm surprised you're still fully intact. Thanks, kid.

Y'know. If you're in the habit of doin' favors, I bet plenty of folk 'round here will have a use for ya. Why don'tcha stick around for a bit?

quests.name: Lost Shipping Crate
quests.objective: Deliver the Lost Shipping Crate to Friz Frazzlespark at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.
quests.description:
<A handwritten label appears on the side of the crate. On the right side is a map with a large red circle along a southeastern shoreline north of a poorly drawn temple surrounded by water and some kind of winged creatures. On the left is a note in massive font.>

PROPERTY OF FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK

POWDERFUSE PORT

WARNING: NOT for tampering. Do NOT open without supervision.

<An additional note appears at the bottom of the label.>

If lost, return to FRIZ FRAZZLESPARK. Powderfuse Port. Riverglades.
quests.completion:
Where did you say you found this? I'm surprised you're still fully intact. Thanks, kid.

Y'know. If you're in the habit of doin' favors, I bet plenty of folk 'round here will have a use for ya. Why don'tcha stick around for a bit?

quests.name: Down the Scarlet Path
quests.objective: Destroy 30 Undead Ravagers, then return to Brother Anton at Nijel's Point.
quests.description:
I will be frank. We are at war with the Scourge. It is an evil that corrupts our people and infects our land. It must be stopped before it overwhelms us and drags our world into shadow. We of the Scarlet Crusade have sworn to fight the Scourge with body and soul.

If you are with us, then gather your courage and prove your allegiance--destroy the undead ravagers of Desolace, in the Valley of Bones to the south.

Do this, and the Crusade will embrace you.
quests.progress: The Scourge grows in power with the passing of each day. If you truly wish to halt its advances, then show me.
quests.completion:
You have proven your resolve, and the Scarlet Crusade commends you.

If you do not shy from righteous slaughter, then perhaps your path lies with us...

quests.name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
quests.objective: Find Karnitol's Chest in Desolace.
quests.description:
My first order of business is for the mage Karnitol--a noble of some sort in Stormwind. Seems his ship was attacked by sea giants while off the coast in the northwest of Desolace. He and his servants tried to bring one of his more valuable chests ashore, but when the sea giants attacked in droves, he chose to abandon it and teleport himself and his servants to safety.

He wants us to find the chest and its contents, and return it to him in Stormwind.
quests.completion:
You notice the chest does not seem to have any water damage.

The second thing you notice is that the top has been forced open, and whatever magical traps were set to safeguard it have long been triggered--this much is obvious from the burn marks around its edges.

quests.name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
quests.objective: Return to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
quests.description:
You take a few moments to figure out what pried the chest open, and you notice along the sides and top of the chest, long, deep scratches that reveal that something other than a man or giant took interest in it. The marks don't appear as if they were caused by dagger or sword.

After going through the chest you find it to be completely empty.

Not having another course of action, you close the chest and prepare to leave. Kreldig will be disappointed.
quests.completion:
Welcome back to Nijel's Point, <name>. So, tell me what you found.

What!? Nothing? An empty chest ain't gonna get us paid, I'm afraid.

Tell me more about these marks you saw... these slashes.

quests.name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
quests.objective: Find Karnitol's Satchel and return it to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
quests.description:
Intriguing.

Well, we might not be without hope quite yet.

Along that same coast, but to the north near Ranazjar Isle, there're night elf ruins at the bottom of the ocean. A tribe of naga, the Slitherblade, make that their home. I think that'd be our best bet.

If a scouting party went that far south, then they must've been pretty powerful. If you're gonna find Karnitol's belongings, I'd start with the more powerful naga: the tidehunters or sea witches.
quests.progress: No offense to whoever Nijel is, but this camp ain't the most comfortable place I've spent a night, if you know what I mean, <name>.
quests.completion:
This is great, <name>! You found Karnitol's belongings!

Those blasted naga, always causing trouble. I think I'd rather spend my life at war with the Horde than have to go against their kind. You've done a great service to the Reclaimers.

quests.name: The Karnitol Shipwreck
quests.objective: Bring Karnitol's Satchel to Roetten Stonehammer in Ironforge.
quests.description:
Take Karnitol's things back to Roetten in Ironforge and he'll pay you for a job well done.

Haha, if you're not careful, he's gonna be so pleased with ya that he'll ask you to join us full time.

Again, great job, <name>.

Be careful on your way back, and don't take too much time--Karnitol's not the most of patient of men, but he's very generous nonetheless.
quests.progress: Business is booming, <name>, and I don't have a lot of time for questions. If you've got business with the Reclaimers, then let's hear it. If not, I'm gonna have to ask you to talk to one of me underlings--they're adept enough at taking care of things 'round here.
quests.completion:
Ah, the Karnitol business in Desolace. Excellent!

So, the chest was destroyed, but the items are all here, huh? Well, I'll let him be the judge of that. One good part about this business I got going on here is that if they're not satisfied, I can tell 'em to shove it! They're relyin' on us to find their stuff... not make sure it's all pretty and in good shape when they get it back.

Good work, <name>. Let's see about gettin' you paid.

quests.name: Bone Collector
quests.objective: Bring 10 Kodo Bones from the Kodo Graveyard to Bibbly F'utzbuckle at Kormek's Hut.
quests.description:
We're sitting on a goldmine here, I tell you - a goldmine! Kodo bones will change the world forever... I have customers making furniture, music instruments, and even blasting powder out of them.

There's a caravan that comes by and picks up my Kodo bones and then sells them at Shadowprey Village. If you can travel to the kodo graveyard south of here and bring me ten Kodo bones, I'll give you something in return. Is it a deal?
quests.progress: Do you have the bones? The caravan will be here any moment. I need just ten more kodo bones to reach a career high. A career high, I tell you!
quests.completion:
Ah, goodie! My bones!

I can't wait till the chaps at home see my face on the front cover of Goblin'preneur. I'll be the richest goblin in the world... and my physical education teacher said I would never amount to anything.

quests.name: Get Me Out of Here!
quests.objective: Escort Melizza Brimbuzzle, then speak with Hornizz Brimbuzzle at the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace.
quests.description:
Get me out of here!

I came up to the Valley of Spears to talk to the Maraudines. I thought I could do a little business with them... but they don't want to talk! I think they want to eat me!

Get me out of here and my brother Hornizz will pay you big! He's at our camp next to the kodo graveyard, to the east.

Let's hurry, <name>. Not two minutes ago I heard some centaurs talking about getting wood for their cookpot...
quests.progress: Have you seen my sister Melizza? She's always on the go, which gets her into trouble all the time.
quests.completion: My sister Melizza said you'd be coming. Thanks a lot for getting her out of the jam she was in; it's too bad that she's already probably found herself in a new one!

quests.name: Ghost-o-plasm Round Up
quests.objective: Bring 8 Ghost-o-plasms and the Crate of Ghost Magnets to Hornizz Brimbuzzle in Desolace.
quests.description:
There's a valley to the southeast, the Valley of Bones, haunted by centaur ghosts. Sounds scary, doesn't it? Well think how scary it is to the centaur!

Here, take this crate of ghost magnets. If you place one between the two big skeletons in the valley, the Dead Goliaths, then ghosts will wander to it. Distance yourself, take out the ghosts and get their ghost-o-plasm.

I have a sneaking suspicion the Magram are VERY interested in this gunk. I plan to sell it to 'em.
quests.progress: Where's my ghost-o-plasm, <name>?
quests.completion:
There it is! Looks like you got some of it on you too. Kinda slimey, eh?

Well, thanks a lot for all the trouble, <name>. This stuff will be worth a fortune... if I can convince the centaurs what it is!

quests.name: Brother Anton
quests.objective: Speak with Brother Anton in Desolace.
quests.description:
My brother in arms, Brother Anton, heard rumors of an undead infestation in distant Kalimdor, in a land known as Desolace. Anton immediately booked passage to that place, to seek and destroy the undead menace!

He is looking for those with the bravery and resolve to aid him. If your heart is true, then speak with Anton. He is in Desolace, in the Alliance town of Nijel's Point.
quests.completion:
I received word of aid arriving from the east. Are you the source of these rumors? Have you come here to help the Scarlet Brother in its crusade?

If so, then listen close...

quests.name: Down the Scarlet Path
quests.objective: Take Brother Anton's Letter of Commendation to Raleigh the Devout in Southshore.
quests.description:
We of the Scarlet Crusade lay claim to strongholds from Hearthglen to Tirisfal Glades. We are quite proud of our bastions of cleansing throughout Lordaeron.

You have proven yourself against the undead in Desolace. But the true threat of the plague lies in Lordaeron.

Travel to the town of Southshore, in the Eastern Kingdoms. Seek out a crusader named Raleigh the Devout. Give him this letter of commendation bearing my seal and he will escort you to a place of honor in our Scarlet Monastery.
quests.progress: Who goes there? What do you want from me?
quests.completion: Brother Anton still spreads the word of the Scarlet Crusade? Oh my....

quests.name: Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.
quests.objective: Bring 10 Felhound Brains, 10 Nether Wings, and 10 vials of Doomwarder Blood to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
quests.description:
This is the last of the items, and I won't lie, it ain't pretty. I'm also expecting this to take you a little bit longer than the other items.

So, enough with the warning, let's get this started. Leftwitch says he needs: ten brains from either mana eaters, mage hunters, or ley hunters. Ten nether wings from a nether maiden, sister or sorceress. And... ten vials of doomwarder blood from a doomwarder captain, or lord.

Simple enough, huh? Sheesh... if you wanna pass on this one, I'd understand.
quests.progress:
I didn't even realize these demon things were in Desolace. Last I read, centaur pretty much owned the land after the night elves picked up and left years ago.

I wonder why they took up here, and how.
quests.completion:
Honestly? I wouldn't have thought it. You're amazing, <name>. Taking on demons for a mage's experiments, and coming back in one piece to boot. Great job!

I'm personally gonna tell Roetten about you when I get back to Ironforge.

quests.name: Reagents for Reclaimers Inc.
quests.objective: Bring Leftwitch's Package back to Roetten Stonehammer in Ironforge.
quests.description:
To get paid, you're gonna have to get back to Ironforge and speak to Roetten himself. He'll love getting Leftwitch's package out of the way anyway. Just give him this and it should be enough to get your booty.

And don't worry, I'm still going to put in a good word for you when I get back. I shouldn't be in Desolace much longer.
quests.progress: Well met, <name>. Business is booming, the sounds of anvils being struck rings throughout Ironforge, the bellows blow the fires hot, and me wife's making me a pie for dessert after tonight's dinner. Could life be any grander?
quests.completion:
Ah, the package for Leftwitch from Desolace. Excellent. I 'preciate the work, and your timeliness, <class>. Glad to have you aboard for at least this small bit of work.

I got your payment right here. Let it be known that Reclaimers Inc. always pays well for a hard week's work.

quests.name: The Corrupter
quests.objective: Slay Lord Azrethoc and Jugkar Grim'rod and return to Takata Steelblade in Desolace.
quests.description:
Although I have no knowledge of this Lord Azrethoc, I agree with Maurin, he must be stopped; especially if he is attempting to gain influence over the Burning Blade to further his goals.

You have already shown you wish to aid the Warchief, and I would trust you to gather a party to slay the demon lord and his warlock servant.

When you are ready, head directly south, and return to me when the threat has been ended.
quests.progress:
Glory to the Horde, and death to our enemies, <name>!

The demons in Desolace pose a greater threat than ever before. My hope of returning to the Warchief dwindles as more and more of the foul creatures seem to appear.

I sometimes wish it was only the centaur we had to deal with.
quests.completion:
A mighty victory for us all, <name>. Let us rejoice in your success. I trust now that our future here is not as bleak as I once thought.

The demons will be slain, the Burning Blade will fail in their efforts, and we may one day have a place we can safely call home again.

quests.name: Highway Robbery
quests.objective: Find someone in Desolace who knows about the pillaged campsite.
quests.description:
The campsite before you is a grisly scene. Judging by the remains, the victims were two humans and a dwarf. Markings on the bones indicate a savage attack, but the looted supplies tell you this wasn't done by an animal. The wounds don't match centaur weaponry either.

Perhaps an experienced scavenger of these lands would know what to make of this.
quests.completion: Ah, so you found another one...

quests.name: On the Lam
quests.objective: Find one of the Desolace marauders.
quests.description:
I've found a couple of scenes like you describe, <name>. Always camps of humans and dwarves. Rumor among the caravans is a group of Horde marauders did it. Seems likely given the victims, and how brutal the attacks were.

Apparently the bandits fled Desolace once an Alliance marshal got hot on their trail.

If you're looking to track one of 'em down, I'd check Booty Bay. Ports always have shady characters coming and going. You might catch one trying to get a boat to somewhere.
quests.completion: You need something? Make it quick.

quests.name: Cherry for Your Thoughts?
quests.objective: Bring a Cherry Grog to Tokal, in Booty Bay, to hear the rest of her story.
quests.description:
You with the marshal? No, you don't look like it.

The rumors you've heard are only half true. Yes, we were pillaging human and dwarven camps, but we weren't doing it for the Horde. We were privately employed.

I'll tell you the whole story if you buy me some grog.
quests.progress: How's that drink coming?
quests.completion: Ah, that's the stuff. Now, where was I?

quests.name: No Honor Among Thieves
quests.objective: Find Illari Duskfeather on the coast of Arathi Highlands, and get access to her cache of stolen loot.
quests.description:
As I was saying...

Our boss wasn't with the Horde. She was a night elf named Illari Duskfeather. She gave us intel on the camps, and even let us keep most of the loot. She only kept a few of the rarer finds.

Once the marshal was on our tail, though, she left us for dead. I don't know her motives, but I think we were set up as patsies.

I'm not the vengeful type, but I won't stop someone else from hunting her down. If you're looking for her, she once mentioned a hideout on the coast of Arathi.
quests.progress: <Using Illari's key, you unlock the cache.>
quests.completion: <Inside of the cache, you find a small box, along with some coin.>

quests.name: A Conqueror's Crown
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Magram, and return a Conqueror's Crown from the Badlands to Warug in Magram Village.
quests.description:
As the strongest centaur clan in all the land, we deserve armaments with ferocity that matches our strength!

Warug needs one most of all. A helm... no, a crown! A conqueror's crown! I heard legends of a fearsome conqueror across the seas. Go to a place they call the Badlands and seek out a crypt there. Return to me only when you have found the crown.

Do this for me, and I will reveal the Magram's greatest strength.
quests.progress: No crown, no talk!
quests.completion:
Look at this! Look at it! What a crown! Befitting of a Khan... but to be worn by Warug. I am pleased.

Are you ready to learn the Magram's newest weapon against our foes?

quests.name: Carved Centaur Totems
quests.objective: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Captain Pentigast at Nijel's Point.
quests.description:
It likely comes as no surprise to you that both of the centaur clans are hesitant to accept aid from anyone outside of their clan. This is especially true for folks like you and me - you know, non-centaurs.

One thing we all have in common is an understanding that money is power, and we have learned that the local centaur barter with carved wood. If you bring me a few samples of their designs, I can put in a rush order for similar etchings. Perhaps we can buy ourselves an advantage.
quests.progress: Have you returned with the totems?
quests.completion:
I am no centaur, but this looks to be a sufficient bundle of totems. Putting myself in their horseshoes, I would be delighted to be gifted this. I even managed to secure a few more while you were out.

Speak with me when you are ready to make the delivery--I trust you to make the right choice with the clan we side with.

quests.name: Carved Centaur Totems
quests.objective: Acquire 5 Carved Centaur Totems by slaying centaur of any clan throughout Desolace, then return them to Gurda Wildmane at Ghost Walker Post.
quests.description:
I have noticed that centaur from different clans sometimes gather away from settlements and engage in trade. I have observed this across numerous nights and seemingly with every clan; most importantly I have seen the currency they use: carved totems.

I believe we can turn the tides in our favor with either the Gelkis or the Magram if we deliver a heavy bundle of totems right to them. I have already begun carving some, but I doubt they will be easily fooled without a few authentic ones.
quests.progress: Have you returned with the totems?
quests.completion:
These are beautiful--I underestimated the creativity of the centaur. I never would have imagined that a race so full of brutality and cruelty would be able to appreciate stories told through carvings.

I suppose appreciating them takes way less effort than crafting them. Let me rephrase: I never would have imagined the centaur to be patient enough to carve out so many tales in wood. Where are they getting the wood?

In any case, speak to me when you are ready to make your delivery.

quests.name: Notes on Draenethyst
quests.objective: Take Gimashi's notes on Draenethyst, and bring them back to Azore Aldamort.
quests.description:
I suppose it would be more accurate to say I know someone who knows a thing or two about draenethyst.

You see, the warlocks of the Burning Blade have been studying it. It is a substance from beyond the dark portal, so it follows that those involved with darker arts might wish to harness it to their own ends. We cannot allow this, obviously.

The specific warlock you seek is named Gimashi. She can be found atop her tower, which is in a ravine to the southeast. Her notes will have the answers you seek.
quests.progress: Our interests are rather well aligned, <name>. By slaying Gimashi, you will have your answers, and I will have one less villain to worry about.
quests.completion: Excellent work! Now, allow me a moment to transcribe these notes into something you and those lovely little bog dwellers can understand.

quests.name: Abridged Notes on Draenethyst
quests.objective: Take Azore's transcribed notes back to Magtoor at the Harborage in Swamp of Sorrows.
quests.description:
I've prepared a transcription of Gimashi's notes on draenethyst. It appears the shards possess some degree of energy, but a pure sphere of the stuff is vastly more powerful. That seems to be what the Burning Blade was after.

Many of Gimashi's notes allude to portals and demonic summoning rituals. Portals to where, or to summon which demons, I cannot say for sure.

While my answers are not definitive, please take these notes back to the swamp with you. I hope you'll understand if I don't come along.
quests.progress: You spoke to the mage? What answers did he have for you?
quests.completion:
<Magtoor begins poring over the notes.>

This is most enlightening. Although, this sphere of draenethyst these notes mention; I have never seen it myself. I imagine you couldn't find one in a place like this, anyhow. If our mere shards already do so much for us, I wonder what we could do with an object of much greater power. Perhaps in finding that sphere, we could also find salvation.

There is much to study and consider here. It may be some time until we speak again. Until then, I thank you deeply.

quests.name: Khan Hratha
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Uthek the Wise in the Gelkis Village.
quests.description:
<name>, you helped us against the Magram. Now, help us beat the Maraudine! Kill the head of their clan, Khan Hratha!

To face him, blow the Maraudine War Horn. It is atop a high bluff in the Valley of Spears.

But to blow the horn, you must gain a warhorn mouthpiece. These are rare, carried only by trusted Maraudine centaur.

After the horn is blown, centaur will come. Kill them until Hratha appears.

Khan Hratha holds the piece of... a key. Bring it to me...
quests.progress: Is Khan Hratha dead? Do you have the key fragment?
quests.completion: He is dead! Khan Hratha is dead! And now the Maraudine will fall! When the Gelkis rule this land, <name>, we will remember you. And the spirits of the earth will sing your name for all time.

quests.name: Khan Hratha
quests.objective: Maintain your Magram reputation, and bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Warug in the Magram Village in Desolace.
quests.description:
The Gelkis Khan is dead, and now the Maraudine will fall! Kill the Maraudine Khan, Hratha!

To face him, blow the horn on the high bluff in the Valley of Spears. But to blow the horn, you need a mouthpiece. To get a mouthpiece, kill Maraudine centaur. Keep killing until you find a mouthpiece. Then blow the horn.

Do this and Maraudine centaur will come to the tower. Kill them until Khan Hratha appears. Hratha holds the piece of a key. Give this piece to me...
quests.progress: Do what I ask. Prove to me that you are an ally of the Magram!
quests.completion:
Khan Hratha is dead! Now the Magram are the strongest of the centaur! We will crush the others, and rule Desolace!

We will remember, you, <name>, and you will be spared our hooves when all others are trampled.

quests.name: Khan Jehn
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Gelkis, and slay Khan Jhen at Magram Village. Once you have succeeded, report to Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village in Desolace.
quests.description:
As much as I would like Uthek or Khan Shaka to give the order, I fear our window of opportunity is short. Too short to consult those at Gelkis Village.

I believe with the situation unfolding here at the Valley of Bones that the Magram have left Khan Jehn with minimal defenses. If there was ever a time to attack another clan's Khan, it is now.

But <name>, a Khan is not to be trifled with, least of all Jehn. If you are brave enough to make your move, you must be swift but do not underestimate him.
quests.progress: I felt a shift in the wind as you approached. Do you bring good news from the Valley of Bones?
quests.completion:
Khan Jehn has been slain!?

I do not believe it. I cannot believe it. This was brazen! Foolish! Nerlokh had no authority to suggest such an attack!

Yet, if you are speaking the truth, I cannot deny that the defeat of Jehn bodes well for the future of our clan. A new Khan will soon take his place, but we have time to prepare our next move.

I will speak with our Khan. For now, your work here is done. Bask in today's victory, but do not tempt fate further.

quests.name: Khan Jehn
quests.objective: Maintain your reputation with the Magram and perform a necromancy ritual to resurrect Khan Jehn. The ritual site can be found in a tent at the central lake of Magram Village.
quests.description:
The leader of our clan, Khan Jehn, was slain by a band of outsiders much like you. They were acting on behalf of the Gelkis Clan.

You can stop feigning your surprise. An assault on Magram Village while our attention was elsewhere is a predictable war strategy, especially for the Gelkis.

Do you know why I am showing no rage or remorse, outsider?

<Orgrul hands you a familiar weapon, imbued with even greater power than the last time you held it.>

This is why.
quests.completion:
The Gelkis recruit outsiders to perform underhanded war strategies, where our clan would send them off to die.

And yet, here you are, <name>. An outsider who has demonstrated fierce loyalty to the Magram Clan despite being so unwelcome.

I do not know your motivations, but I recognize first-hand your potential. You have my gratitude, and that of our clan.

To us, you are no longer an outsider. To us, you are Magram.

quests.name: Khan Hratha
quests.objective: Bring the Maraudine Key Fragment to Umarak in the Desolace.
quests.description:
While war rages throughout the region, the Maraudine centaur stand unchallenged in the Valley of Spears. I worry that they will grow callous in time and stir further unrest if the other clans continue to turn a blind eye to their presence.

Khan Hratha possesses a Maraudine Key Fragment, and I wish to have it as a negotiation tactic. Find a war horn mouthpiece from the centaur there and use it to challenge him atop the highest peak.

Bring the key to me, and I will have a proposition for you.
quests.progress: Is Khan Hratha dead? Do you have the key fragment?
quests.completion:
With Khan Hratha slain and the key fragment away from the Valley of Spears, you have done well to disrupt that clan's strength--all without drawing attention from the more pressing war at hand.

I suspect the Maraudine will come looking for this before long, but the death of their khan ought to delay any aggressive tactics for a short time.

I have some goods I scavenged that you can pick from, and some carved totems to aid in your own negotiations.

quests.name: Buying Friendship: Magram
quests.objective: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
quests.description:
Siding with the Magram would be my choice. There is no question that they are the dominant clan in the present day, regardless of their previous struggles. I have heard reports that they are brutally hostile against the Gelkis.

I sympathize with both warring clans and especially the Gelkis, but this is their war; not ours. We ought to side with the faction that poses the least risk to our cause. I believe that to be the Magram.

Bring this to their quartermaster in Magram Village to the southeast.
quests.progress: What business does an outsider have with Gorhak?
quests.completion:
<Gorhak's eyes widen as you offer up the bundle of carved totems, but his brow furrows as his eyes flick back up toward you.>

I am no fool, outsider. This donation is not without cause. You want something, either from me or from our clan. I do not know what.

<With a single swipe of his hand, the quartermaster claims the bag as his own.>

And today, I do not care what your ulterior motive might be.

Welcome to Magram Village, outsider.

quests.name: Buying Friendship: Gelkis
quests.objective: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.
quests.description:
At first glance, I would wager that the Gelkis are struggling. Their numbers are far fewer than the Magram, and I rarely hear of them stomping around from our scouts.

Nonetheless, they are one of the dominant clans in the Desolace and survive to this day. They must be doing something right.

If you want to make peace with the Gelkis, take this tote of totems with you to Gelkis Village far to the southwest. Primitive as they may be, they are likely to have a treasurer of some kind.
quests.progress: An outsider this deep in the village? You best be bringing business.
quests.completion:
<Molkar peeks into the bag. A smirk tugs on his lips, which paused only briefly as he caught a glimpse of a clearly fake totem. He pretends to not see it.>

I do not know what possessed an outsider to bring our clan such a gift. It is a great boon for our people, as the Magram Clan have been unusually vicious as of late.

You no longer need to tread carefully in our village. I will inform Uthek, who will speak with the Khan.

quests.name: Buying Friendship: Magram
quests.objective: Bring the Totem Tote to the Magram Quartermaster at Magram Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Magram Clan Centaur.
quests.description:
The fierce Magram are undoubtedly winning the war of territories at the moment. While we can all be thankful the clashes haven't erupted too frequently throughout the desert, every day their village just to the east grows a little bigger; their soldiers a little bolder.

I worry gravely about the consequences of an unchecked Magram clan, but I cannot deny their potential as an ally.

If you wish to earn their trust, offer this sack of totems to their quartermaster, but be careful.
quests.progress: What business does an outsider have with Gorhak?
quests.completion:
<Gorhak's eyes widen as you offer up the bundle of carved totems, but his brow furrows as his eyes flick back up toward you.>

I am no fool, outsider. This donation is not without cause. You want something, either from me or from our clan. I do not know what.

<With a single swipe of his hand, the quartermaster claims the bag as his own.>

And today, I do not care what your ulterior motive might be.

Welcome to Magram Village, outsider.

quests.name: Buying Friendship: Gelkis
quests.objective: Bring the Totem Tote to the Gelkis Quartermaster at Gelkis Village in the Desolace to significantly increase your reputation with that clan. You must be of at least Neutral standing with the Gelkis Clan Centaur.
quests.description:
Either dominant centaur clan is likely to pose a good ally, but I ought to offer a word of caution regarding the Gelkis.

I have trustworthy intel that suggests, between the Magram and the Gelkis, the latter are very much on the losing side. This may work to our advantage--desperation may push the isolated clan into opening up to outside help.

I have prepared a tote of totems for you to take to their quartermaster, assuming they have one, in Gelkis Village. This may work in our favor.
quests.progress: An outsider this deep in the village? You best be bringing business.
quests.completion:
<Molkar peeks into the bag. A smirk tugs at his lips, falling only briefly as he catches a glimpse of a clearly fake totem. He pretends to not see it.>

I do not know what possessed an outsider to bring our clan such a gift. It is a great boon for our people, as the Magram Clan have been unusually vicious as of late.

You no longer need to tread carefully in our village. I will inform Uthek, who will speak with the Khan.

quests.name: The Testament of Rexxar
quests.objective: Deliver Rexxar's Testament to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.
quests.description:
What do you know of illusions, <name>? For you see, it is an illusion that you must create in order to circumvent the Black Flight's defenses.

I know of one that may be willing to assist you in your quest of deception. She has assisted our kind in the past when she has deemed the cause worthy.

In the Western Plaguelands you will find Myranda the Hag, master illusionist - an exile of the Lordaeron alliance. Travel there and take with you this message.
quests.progress: It is not often I see one of the Horde in these parts of Lordaeron. What is it that you have for Myranda?
quests.completion:
<Myranda holds the note, pauses, then smiles.>

How is he? Rexxar, I mean. Oh, come now, do not look so confused. The letter was left intentionally blank. It carried with it the intentions and thoughts of its creator. Judging from its contents, it is no wonder Rexxar left it as such. Imagine if you were captured or slain and this information discovered!

Oh, nevermind! Myranda will help you, <race>. I owe the Warchief a favor or two.

quests.name: Economic Warfare
quests.progress:
One thing that war has taught us: money is power.

All centaur in Desolace have come to an agreement to barter with intricately carved wood that shares tales of a centaur's own glory and conquests. It serves as the only reprieve from battle, and only the most level-headed are permitted to engage with other clans.

I have seen your kind trade in gold and silver. Worthless to us, as our totems are to you. Bring me some, and the Magram Clan will be pleased.
quests.completion: A wise decision, outsider. Your generosity will not go unnoticed.

quests.name: Economic Warfare
quests.progress:
Long ago, all of the centaur clans in the Desolace agreed to trade in story. Specifically, carved totems that represent an individual or clan's great accomplishments. Despite the endless conflict, all clans continue to honor this tradition, even if trade opportunities between us have become few and far between.

Should you collect any, such as from fallen centaur of other clans, bring them to me. The Gelkis can use more bartering power, and I will inform the Khan of your assistance.
quests.completion: I will add these to our collection. Our power grows thanks to your contributions, though we have a long way to go if we are to overcome the Magram Clan.
